description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for the sixth-order 2-D rule(s) driven by problems/heat_2d_x_dirichlet_o6.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). The manufactured solution is exact for the continuous PDE (derivation in the problem file); the steady linear/ramp component is discretely exact for the sixth-order operator (all closure weight-sums are zero), so the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 are spatial sixth-order truncation from the smooth decaying mode (at the finest resolutions the errors approach the integrator/roundoff floor, giving the mild pre-asymptotic order scatter documented for the 1-D o6 siblings). expected_order 6.0; the honestly observed order is pinned by golden/errors.json.
